title: Chess.com Accounts Kept Growing After the Release Spike
hook: The television bump became a lasting online chess habit.
closing: A release sparked attention, but the platform's own totals show the habit kept spreading.
question: What pulled you into chess?

segments.say: Chess.com reported 200 million registered accounts. The platform's total kept climbing years after the release spike.
Monthly Chess.com signups reached 2.8 million after the release. A surge accelerated growth already underway.
Chess.com accounts equal about one-third of estimated regular players. The comparison suggests room to grow, not unique people verified.
